The central focus is a raised table covered in a white cloth, adorned with golden candlesticks and a floral arrangement. Behind the table stands a large, elaborate stone or marble reredos (altarpiece) featuring religious statuary and carvings within a niche. The altar is flanked by tall columns decorated with painted panels depicting biblical scenes.
